spans.s: कोणः [kōṇḥ], [कुण्-करणे घञ् कर्त्तरि अच् वा Tv.]
A corner, an angle (of anything); भयेन कोणे क्वचन स्थितस्य
An intermediate point of the compass.
The bow of a lute; a fiddle-stick.
The sharp edge of a sword or weapon.

A sort of musical instrument [cf. Gr. gonia]. -Comp. -आघातः striking of drums, tabors &c., used in the sense of 'a mingled sound of various musical instruments'; कोणाघातेषु गर्जत्प्रलयघनघटान्योन्य- संघट्टचण्डः

. (It is thus defined by Bharata: ढक्काशतसहस्राणि भेरीशतशतानि च । एकदा यत्र हन्यन्ते कोणाघातः स उच्यते ॥). -कुणः, -पारावतम् (see कपोतपालिका) A dove-cot or doveridge, a bug. -वादिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.-वृत्तम् a vertical circle extending from north-east to south-west or from north-west to south-east. -शङ्कुः the sinus of the height of the sun.
कोणाकोणी [kōṇākōṇī], ind. From angle to angle, corner-wise, diagonally.
कोणि [kōṇi], a. Having a crooked hand.
